pages.title: That’s the Sizzle
pages.text: Learn frying through a finished dish.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Heat the Wok, use oil and a Spatula, then collect the finished food. The wok recipe view shows Fried Eggs.

pages.title: Cook in a wok
pages.text: A Wok needs heat, oil, ingredients, a Spatula and timely serving. An unsuitable mixture or overcooking can spoil the result.

pages.title: Avoid a failed dish
pages.text: Wrong ingredients or delays can spoil Wok cooking. Opening a Stockpot pauses processing; incorrect steps produce a suspicious result.
